condition_types.EVENT: Fires at a specific moment — tight, precise
condition_types.STATE: Can be true for hours — use only as filter, never alone

_legend.rule: Every set must have at least 1 EVENT condition as anchor

buy_sets.name: BUY_RSI_MACD_REVERSAL
buy_sets.notes: Oversold momentum recovery confirmed by a bullish reversal candle. Classic intraday bottom reversal.

buy_sets.name: BUY_EMA_TREND_PULLBACK
buy_sets.notes: Buy the dip in an active uptrend. EMA9 > EMA21 confirms uptrend state, RSI recovering from a mild dip, bullish candle confirms the reversal point. Removed price_above_ema20 (redundant STATE) and replaced with candle EVENT anchor.

buy_sets.name: BUY_EMA_VOLUME_MOMENTUM
buy_sets.notes: EMA 9/21 crossover with strong volume participation. MACD positive confirms bullish regime — prevents buying a dead-cat bounce where MACD is still negative.

buy_sets.name: BUY_MACD_VWAP_SURGE
buy_sets.notes: MACD bullish regime + price above VWAP + volume surge + bullish candle. Added bullish_reversal_candle as EVENT anchor — without it 2 STATE conditions would fire continuously on any uptrending stock.

buy_sets.name: BUY_BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION
buy_sets.notes: 4-gate fakeout filter. volume_breakout is a strong EVENT anchor. price_above_ema20, price_above_vwap, rsi_not_overbought are filters that eliminate false breakouts. Note: price_above_ema20 is slightly redundant (volume_breakout already checks SMA20) but kept as extra VWAP zone filter.

_conditions_audit.volume_breakout: EVENT — primary anchor (vol spike + price broke prior high + above SMA20)
_conditions_audit.price_above_ema20: STATE — filter (breakout must be in trend)
_conditions_audit.price_above_vwap: STATE — filter (must be in institutional zone)
_conditions_audit.rsi_not_overbought: STATE — filter (RSI < 65 — not buying at exhaustion)

buy_sets.name: BUY_BOLLINGER_REVERSAL
buy_sets.notes: Mean-reversion bounce from lower Bollinger Band with bullish candle structure confirming the reversal. Works well in ranging intraday conditions.

_conditions_audit.bollinger_band_bounce: EVENT — touched lower band + bounced + RSI < 45

buy_sets.name: BUY_VWAP_REVERSAL
buy_sets.notes: Price reclaims VWAP while RSI recovers and bullish candle structure appears. VWAP is the most important intraday reference — reclaim = trend resumption. bullish_reversal_candle is the EVENT anchor preventing noise.

sell_sets.name: SELL_EMA_MOMENTUM_LOSS
sell_sets.notes: Early exit. Price breaks below EMA20 (EVENT) and RSI confirms weakening momentum (SEMI). Fast, reliable, no candle dependency.

_conditions_audit.ema20_breakdown: EVENT — anchor (price crossed below EMA20 in lookback window)

sell_sets.name: SELL_VWAP_RSI_REVERSAL
sell_sets.notes: Price loses VWAP + RSI weakening + EMA breakdown. Added ema20_breakdown as EVENT anchor. Without it, price_below_vwap (STATE) + rsi_weakening (SEMI) would fire continuously in any afternoon downtrend.

sell_sets.name: SELL_MACD_EMA_WEAKNESS
sell_sets.notes: MACD bearish cross aligned with EMA20 breakdown. Both are EVENT conditions — this is the tightest, most reliable sell set. High conviction exit.

sell_sets.name: SELL_EMA_CROSS_WEAKNESS
sell_sets.notes: EMA9 below EMA21 (STATE) + price below VWAP (STATE) + MACD bearish cross (EVENT). Critical fix: original had 2 pure STATE conditions — would fire every 5 seconds in a downtrend. macd_bearish_cross added as mandatory EVENT anchor.

sell_sets.name: SELL_BREAKDOWN_CONFIRMED
sell_sets.notes: Support broken AND EMA confirms breakdown. Both are EVENT conditions. Reliable structural exit — not noise, not a fake dip.

sell_sets.name: SELL_RSI_BEARISH_REVERSAL
sell_sets.notes: Overbought RSI (> 70) with a bearish candle pattern. Momentum exhaustion at the top. bearish_pattern is the EVENT anchor.

_conditions_audit.bearish_pattern: EVENT — anchor (bearish engulfing or shooting star)
